# Vendored UI styles

`tabler-1.6.1.min.css` is the CSS distribution from `@tabler/core@1.6.1`.
Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/releases/tag/%40tabler%2Fcore%401.6.1
License: MIT, included in `TABLER-LICENSE.txt`.

The source map reference was removed. No library JavaScript, remote stylesheets,
fonts, or third-party services are loaded. All application behavior remains in
`../app.js`; visual tokens and component customization are in `../theme.css`.
